narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Fixed. Suite is green, 625/625 passing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) was charging tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted total. Changed it to tax `discounted` instead of `cents`.

No further action needed.
